## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

Import data


```{r}

read_excel_sheets_with_names <- function(file_path) {
  # Get all sheet names
  sheet_names <- excel_sheets(file_path)
  print(sheet_names)
  # Read each sheet into a tibble, adding the sheet name as a column
  sheet_data <- map(
    sheet_names,
    ~ read_excel(file_path, sheet = .x, skip = 4, trim_ws = TRUE) |>
      mutate(Area = as.numeric(Area)) |>
      filter(!is.na(Filename)) |>
      mutate(sheet = .x)
  )

  # Optionally combine all sheets into one tibble
  combined_data <- bind_rows(sheet_data)

  return(combined_data)
}
```

Define function for reading in these wonky excel sheets, which I converted from .xls to .xlsx:

```{r}
read_excel_sheets_with_names <- function(file_path) {
  # Get all sheet names
  sheet_names <- excel_sheets(file_path)

  # Create a safe version of read_excel
  safe_read <- safely(function(sheet) {
    read_excel(file_path, sheet = sheet, skip = 4, trim_ws = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(compound = sheet) |>
      mutate(
        Height = as.numeirc(Height),
        Area = as.numeric(Area),
        RT = as.numeric(RT)
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(Filename))
  })

  # Attempt to read each sheet
  sheet_results <- map(sheet_names, safe_read)

  # Extract only the successful reads
  valid_sheets <- sheet_results %>%
    keep(~ is.null(.x$error)) %>%
    map("result")

  # Optionally warn about skipped sheets
  failed_sheets <- sheet_names[map_lgl(sheet_results, ~ !is.null(.x$error))]
  if (length(failed_sheets) > 0) {
    warning(
      "The following sheets could not be read and were skipped: ",
      paste(failed_sheets, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Combine all valid tibbles into one
  combined_data <- bind_rows(valid_sheets)

  return(combined_data)
}
```


```{r}
vapor_sip <- read_excel_sheets_with_names(
  "data/GCMS Data/Vapor_SIP_FAMES.xlsx"
) |>
  mutate(compound = str_replace(compound, "_", ":")) |>
  select(
    filename = Filename,
    compound,
    area = Area,
    rt = RT
  )
```

```{r}
# combine datasets and add in some metadata
gcms_data <- liquid_sip |>
  bind_rows(vapor_sip) |>
  # filter out injections we don't want:
  filter(!filename %in% c("Created By:", "User Name", "TSQ9000")) |>
  filter(str_detect(filename, "blank", negate = TRUE)) |>
  filter(str_detect(filename, "BLANK", negate = TRUE)) |>
  filter(str_detect(filename, "BAME", negate = TRUE)) |>
  filter(str_detect(filename, "PAIBE", negate = TRUE)) |>
  # filter out PAIBE
  filter(compound != "PAIBE") |>
  mutate(
    SIP_type = case_when(
      str_sub(filename, 3, 3) == "V" ~ "Vapor-SIP",
      str_sub(filename, 3, 3) == "W" ~ "Liquid-SIP"
    ),
    site = case_when(
      str_sub(filename, 1, 1) == "J" ~ "JCR",
      str_sub(filename, 1, 1) == "L" ~ "Loma Ridge"
    ),
    drought = case_when(
      str_sub(filename, 2, 2) == "R" ~ "Drought",
      str_sub(filename, 2, 2) == "S" ~ "No Drought"
    ),
    dt_hr = as.numeric(str_extract(filename, "(?<=\\D)(\\d{1,2})(?=_)"))
  ) |>
  select(
    filename,
    site,
    drought,
    dt_hr,
    SIP_type,
    everything()
  ) |>
  # Based on our PAIBE, the instrument responds 73560108466 area per µg. So µg = area / 73560108466
  mutate(
    ug_injected = area / 73560108466,
    ug_total = ug_injected * 200, # 1 uL injected from 200 uL hexane extract
  ) |>
  # rename compounds
  mutate(
    compound = str_replace_all(compound, "_", ":"),
    # fix some names
    compound = case_when(
      compound == "19:0:(cyclo)" ~ "19:0 (cyclo)",
      compound == "2-OH:16:0" ~ "2-OH 16:0",
      compound == "17:0:(cyclo)" ~ "17:0 (cyclo)",
      compound == "3-OH:14:0" ~ "3-OH 14:0",
      compound == "2-OH:14:0" ~ "2-OH 14:0",
      compound == "3-OH:12:0" ~ "3-OH 12:0",
      compound == "2-OH:12:0" ~ "2-OH 12:0",
      compound == "2-OH:10:0" ~ "2-OH 10:0",
      TRUE ~ compound
    )
  )
```

Calculate recovery of the internal standard. We added 50 ug of 23:0 PC to each extraction

```{r}
extraction_standard <- gcms_data |>
  filter(compound == "23:0") |>
  rename(ug_23PC_recovered = ug_total) |>
  # we added 50 ug of 23:0 PC to each extraction
  mutate(ug_23PC_added = 50) |>
  mutate(fraction_recovered = ug_23PC_recovered / ug_23PC_added) |>
  mutate(percent_recovered = fraction_recovered * 100)

extraction_standard |>
  select(site, drought, dt_hr, SIP_type, percent_recovered) |>
  arrange(site, drought, dt_hr) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::data_color(percent_recovered, palette = "Blues")
```

Join the recovery data back in:


```{r}
gcms_data_w_recovery <- gcms_data |>
  left_join(
    extraction_standard |> select(filename, fraction_recovered),
    by = "filename"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ug_extracted = ug_total / fraction_recovered,
    ug_per_g_soil = ug_extracted / 5 # 5 g of soil extracted
  ) |>
  mutate(
    site_abbrev = str_sub(site, 1, 1),
    drought_abbrev = case_when(
      drought == "Drought" ~ "R",
      drought == "No Drought" ~ "S"
    ),
    SIP_type_abbrev = case_when(
      SIP_type == "Vapor-SIP" ~ "V",
      SIP_type == "Liquid-SIP" ~ "W"
    ),
    compound = case_when(
      compound == "2-OH:10_0" ~ "2-OH_10:0",
      compound == "2-OH:12_0" ~ "2-OH_12:0",
      compound == "2-OH:14_0" ~ "2-OH_14:0",
      compound == "2-OH:16_0" ~ "2-OH_16:0",
      compound == "3-OH:12_0" ~ "3-OH_12:0",
      compound == "3-OH:14_0" ~ "3-OH_14:0",
      TRUE ~ compound
    ),
    clean_id = paste0(site_abbrev, drought_abbrev, SIP_type_abbrev, dt_hr)
  ) |>
  select(-c(site_abbrev, drought_abbrev, SIP_type_abbrev))
```

## Plot

```{r}
gcms_data_w_recovery |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = dt_hr,
      y = ug_per_g_soil,
      color = compound,
      shape = SIP_type
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(site ~ drought) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Summarize


```{r}
gcms_data_w_recovery |> colnames()

lipid_totals <- gcms_data_w_recovery |>
  select(clean_id, site, drought, dt_hr, SIP_type, compound, ug_per_g_soil) |>
  group_by(clean_id, site, drought, dt_hr, SIP_type) |>
  summarise(
    total_ug_per_g_soil = sum(ug_per_g_soil, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

lipid_totals |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = as.factor(dt_hr),
      y = total_ug_per_g_soil,
      fill = SIP_type
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5, preserve = "single"),
    width = 0.5,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(vars(site, drought), scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)
  )
```

export to cache


```{r}
lipid_totals |> knitr::kable()

lipid_totals |> saveRDS("cache/lipid_abundances.rds")
```
